address: 195 Cuba Street, Te Aro, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: Kisa reinterprets Turkish-Levantine culinary traditions with creative, modern twists. Try salmon kibbeh nayeh that uses minced fish instead of raw meat, seasoned with allspice and served with pita bread. Rich smoky flavours, which underpin much of the culinary lineup, are courtesy of a charcoal grill. Don’t miss the chargrilled kebab skewers or zucchini over a yoghurt dip and sprinkled with pumpkin seeds, spices, harissa and paprika oil.
